STATUS: license file MISSING from repo

Source URL: https://kenney.nl/assets/ui-pack
Pack Name: Kenney UI Pack
Reported License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0 Universal)

Files currently used in public/:
- public/assets/fonts/kenney-future.ttf
- public/assets/fonts/kenney-future-narrow.ttf
- public/assets/audio/ui-click.ogg

Audit Note:
The existing provenance document cited 'Kenney UI Pack' and claimed all license files were included. Both claims are incorrect:
1. The only physical License.txt file present in the repository archives was inside `docs/source-assets/kenney_ui-pack-adventure.zip` (version 1.1).
2. The fonts and click sound in `phase1-futuristic-asset-pack.zip` were not accompanied by their official pack License.txt file.
Therefore, the license file for Kenney UI Pack is missing from the repository.
